origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model gemini-2.5-pro: a relay whose prompt_tokens leaves out the cache reads and includes the cache writes; 2000 tokens in, 1500 of them read from the cache and 100 written to it; the member says so (the result is the same bill in the four cases). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
